versions.changelog: v1.1.0: Added save script with error handling, edge cases, trigger coverage, agent owner

save-to-obsidian 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Save markdown content to a remote Obsidian vault via SSH (for non-iCloud-sync environments)
- Enforces Obsidian-compatible formatting: requires Mermaid for diagrams and markdown tables for data
- Uses SCP to transfer notes and confirms success to the user
- Automatically cleans up temporary files after transfer
- Requires SSH configuration and vault path defined in the workspace TOOLS.md
